title: There's A Fountain Free
firstLine: There's a fountain free, 'tis for you and me;

lines: There's a fountain free, 'tis for you and me;
Let us hast, O hast to its brink;
'Tis the fount of love from the Source above,
And He bids us all freely drink.
There's a living stream, with a crystal gleam:
From the throne of life now it flows;
While the waters roll let the weary soul
Hear the call that forth freely goes.
There's a rock that's cleft and no soul is left,
That my not its pure waters share;
'Tis for you and me, and its stream I see:
Will you come (will you come) to the fountain free?
Will you come (Will you come,'tis for you and me;
Thirsty soul (thirsty soul,) hear the welcome call:
